title_lines: 巴西大选首轮结果出炉
雷亚尔与权益资产走强
title_highlights: 巴西大选首轮结果出炉
雷亚尔与权益资产走强

subtitles.en: And Brazilian assets are opposed to rally after a Flavio Bolsonaro's surprise first round election lead over present Lula.
subtitles.zh: 巴西资产在弗拉维奥·博索纳罗首轮选举意外领先卢拉后出现上涨。

subtitles.en: Bolsonaro won roughly 47% to Lula's 45%, setting up an October 25th runoff, investors
subtitles.zh: 博索纳罗以约47%对45%领先卢拉，进入10月25日的第二轮投票，市场参与者

subtitles.en: see the results as increasing prospects for physical tightening with the real rates and domestically focused stocks expected to benefit.
subtitles.zh: 认为结果增加了实际利率收紧的可能性，国内导向的权益资产预计将受益。

subtitles.en: For more on the election, Bloomberg's Travis Waldron joins us from Brazil.
subtitles.zh: 更多选举内容，彭博的Travis Waldron从巴西连线。

subtitles.en: Travis, just break down for us. How big of a surprise was this to see Bolsonaro's lead?
subtitles.zh: Travis，请分析一下。博索纳罗领先有多令人意外？

subtitles.en: The fact that he took the lead is the surprise here.
subtitles.zh: 他取得领先本身就是意外。

subtitles.en: Most polls before the race had expected Lula to exit the first round with a little bit of a lead, and the focus was on the margin that he might have.
subtitles.zh: 选前多数民调预计卢拉将以小幅领先进入第二轮，焦点在于他的领先幅度。
en_highlights: a little bit of a lead

subtitles.en: Instead, it's Bolsonaro who takes the lead, which will position him as a clear front runner going into the runoff on October 25th.
subtitles.zh: 相反，博索纳罗取得领先，这使他在10月25日第二轮投票前成为明显的领跑者。

subtitles.en: It's notable that while the gap is only two points, since Brazil returned to democracy in 1989, no candidate who finished second in the first round has overcome that to win
subtitles.zh: 值得注意的是，尽管差距仅两个百分点，但自1989年巴西恢复民主以来，首轮排名第二的候选人从未在第二轮中反超获胜。

subtitles.en: the election in the runoff stage. So just switching to the market reaction here, it seems like positioning was a little bit flat.
subtitles.zh: 转向市场反应，似乎仓位有些平淡。
en_highlights: positioning was a little bit flat

subtitles.en: Everyone's caught a little bit surprised here by just the size of the performance that Bolsonaro was able to give.
subtitles.zh: 博索纳罗的表现规模让所有人都有些意外。

subtitles.en: Brazil has a tendency to overreact and chase. Were you at this?
subtitles.zh: 巴西市场容易过度反应和追涨。你当时在场吗？

subtitles.en: You think it's going to be something similar now? We're going to have a little bit of a ramp up in some of these trades now into the actual election?
subtitles.zh: 你觉得现在会类似吗？进入实际选举前，一些交易会有所升温？
